description: Application service registration and network settings. Maps to mautrix bridgev2/bridgeconfig.AppserviceConfig.

address.description: The full public address of the appservice (e.g. http://bridge:29318).

public_address.description: Public-facing address if different from address.

hostname.description: Hostname to bind the appservice listener to.

port.description: Port to bind the appservice listener to.

id.description: Unique appservice ID, used in the registration file.

as_token.description: Appservice token used to authenticate requests to the homeserver.

hs_token.description: Homeserver token used to authenticate requests from the homeserver.

ephemeral_events.description: Receive ephemeral events (typing, receipts) via appservice transactions.

username_template.description: Go text/template for generating ghost user localparts. Receives the remote username as {{.}}.

BotUserConfig.description: Configuration for the appservice bot user. Maps to mautrix BotUserConfig.

username.description: Localpart of the bot user (e.g. 'bot' for @bot:example.com).

displayname.description: Display name to set for the bot user.

avatar.description: Avatar mxc:// URI for the bot user. Set to 'remove' to remove the avatar.
